<script>

(function(){

const months=[
{year:2026,month:11},
{year:2027,month:0},
{year:2027,month:1},
{year:2027,month:2},
{year:2027,month:3}
];

const monthNames=[
"January","February","March","April","May","June",
"July","August","September","October","November","December"
];

const ranges=[
{start:"2026-12-01",end:"2026-12-24",season:"shoulder"},
{start:"2026-12-25",end:"2027-03-10",season:"high"},
{start:"2027-03-11",end:"2027-04-30",season:"shoulder"}
];

function parseDate(str){
const [y,m,d]=str.split("-").map(Number);
return new Date(y,m-1,d);
}

function getSeason(date){
for(const r of ranges){
const start=parseDate(r.start);
const end=parseDate(r.end);
if(date>=start && date<=end) return r.season;
}
return "";
}

function buildMonth(year,month,index){

const monthEl=document.createElement("div");
monthEl.className="pkh-month";
monthEl.dataset.index=index;
monthEl.dataset.label=monthNames[month]+" "+year;

const header=document.createElement("div");
header.className="pkh-month-header";
header.textContent=monthNames[month]+" "+year;
monthEl.appendChild(header);

const weekdays=document.createElement("div");
weekdays.className="pkh-weekdays";

["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"].forEach(d=>{
const el=document.createElement("div");
el.textContent=d;
weekdays.appendChild(el);
});

monthEl.appendChild(weekdays);

const daysGrid=document.createElement("div");
daysGrid.className="pkh-days";

const firstDay=new Date(year,month,1);
const totalDays=new Date(year,month+1,0).getDate();

let offset=firstDay.getDay();
offset=offset===0?6:offset-1;

for(let i=0;i<offset;i++){
const empty=document.createElement("div");
empty.className="pkh-pad";
empty.innerHTML="&nbsp;";
daysGrid.appendChild(empty);
}

for(let d=1;d<=totalDays;d++){

const date=new Date(year,month,d);
const season=getSeason(date);

const day=document.createElement("div");

if(season==="shoulder") day.className="pkh-day pkh-shoulder";
else if(season==="high") day.className="pkh-day pkh-high";
else day.className="pkh-day";

day.textContent=d;

daysGrid.appendChild(day);
}

const cellsUsed = offset + totalDays;
const totalCells = 35;
const trailingPads = totalCells - cellsUsed;

for(let i=0;i<trailingPads;i++){
const empty=document.createElement("div");
empty.className="pkh-pad";
empty.innerHTML="&nbsp;";
daysGrid.appendChild(empty);
}

monthEl.appendChild(daysGrid);
return monthEl;
}

const container=document.getElementById("pkh-calendars");
months.forEach(({year,month},index)=>{
container.appendChild(buildMonth(year,month,index));
});

const monthEls=[...container.querySelectorAll(".pkh-month")];
const prevBtn=document.getElementById("pkh-prev");
const nextBtn=document.getElementById("pkh-next");
const mobileLabel=document.getElementById("pkh-mobile-label");
let activeIndex=0;

function isMobile(){
return window.innerWidth<=520;
}

function updateMobileView(){
if(!monthEls.length) return;

monthEls.forEach((el,i)=>{
el.classList.toggle("is-active", i===activeIndex);
});

if(mobileLabel){
mobileLabel.textContent=monthEls[activeIndex].dataset.label;
}

if(prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled=activeIndex===0;
if(nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled=activeIndex===monthEls.length-1;
}

function goToMonth(index){
activeIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(index,monthEls.length-1));
updateMobileView();
}

if(prevBtn){
prevBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>goToMonth(activeIndex-1));
}

if(nextBtn){
nextBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>goToMonth(activeIndex+1));
}

let touchStartX=0;
let touchEndX=0;

container.addEventListener("touchstart", (e)=>{
if(!isMobile()) return;
touchStartX=e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
}, {passive:true});

container.addEventListener("touchend", (e)=>{
if(!isMobile()) return;
touchEndX=e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
const delta=touchEndX-touchStartX;

if(Math.abs(delta)>40){
if(delta<0) goToMonth(activeIndex+1);
if(delta>0) goToMonth(activeIndex-1);
}
}, {passive:true});

window.addEventListener("resize", updateMobileView);
updateMobileView();

})();

</script>
        
        
        
      
    
  
  
    



  
</div>

      --scale-y: 100%;

      --skew-y: 0deg;

      --origin-y: 50%;

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">What do our seasons mean?</h3><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Panama’s windy season runs from December to April, with trade winds throughout the season.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Our <strong>high season</strong> and <strong>shoulder season</strong> labels mainly reflect pricing and demand - not whether it is windy. <br>January to March is the busiest time in Punta Chame, while December and April are generally quieter, so we offer lower accommodation rates during these months.</p>
</div>

<div class="sqs-block-socialaccountlinks-content">
  <div class="sqs-svg-icon--outer social-icon-alignment-center social-icons-color-black social-icons-size-extra-small social-icons-style-regular ">
    <style>
      
      #block-yui_3_17_2_1_1626118551549_17345 {
        --social-icons-justify-content: center;
        --social-icons-dimension: 16px;--social-icons-gap: 10px;
